summary: The change adds two closed allowlist branches to extractSelfFailureSignature: the GitHub App token repository-access refusal now maps to app-token:repository-access before the exit-code branch, and a timestamped or bare ##[error] annotation without an error: prefix maps to the existing error class after the shutdown, type, assertion, generic-error, exit and cancellation checks. Both branches emit only fixed summaries, so no log text, repository name or URL reaches the marker, title or body, and the new tests pin the maintenance key, title, dedup, warning/notice exclusion and sanitization.

evidence: docs/DECISIONS.md lines 6752-6756 record every supervisor run failing at Mint the scoped sentinel App token with HTTP 422 There is at least one repository that does not exist or is not accessible to the parent installation, which is the maintenance failure issue 426 observed.

ops/self-defects.ts lines 146-158 add that refusal as the closed signature app-token:repository-access, checked before the exit-code fallback, so the maintenance job no longer yields job:observed with no allowlisted log pattern.

ops/self-defects.ts lines 188-198 add a sanitized ##[error] annotation class after the more specific shutdown, type, assertion, exit and cancellation checks, covering the reported no-allowlisted-pattern gap for annotation-only failures.

tests/repair/self_defects_test.ts and tests/repair/hosted_self_observation_test.ts pin the maintenance signature, title and marker, one-time filing and that no directory names or paths enter the filed issue.
